close_reason: Landed commit 7356cd6. ChangeRecord construction extracted from create_object / update_object / destroy_object into ChangeRecord::from_stored_value(id, &val). The three previously byte-identical inline blocks (each unwrap_or with the same fallback shape on relatedType / @type) collapse into a single call. The constructor's rustdoc carries the load-bearing capture-at-mutation invariant (bd:JMAP-ayoz.19): snapshot the strings BEFORE the value moves into or out of the objects store; the destroy path in particular cannot recover them post-mortem. A future contributor adding a fourth mutation point now reuses the constructor and inherits the invariant rather than writing a freshly-different inline shape. No behaviour change. 50 unit tests + 26 integration tests + 3 log-redaction tests continue to pass. Quality gates: cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, doc -D warnings, all green.
title: ChangeRecord-from-value triplication across MemoryBackend create/update/destroy_object
